Major US online retailer @Newegg has started accepting Dogecoin as the "official payment method" for orders on its website.
Newegg decided to support #DogeDay with this announcement.
#CoinsPaidMedia #Crypto #Cryptonews https://t.co/mYB8Ru9yjb

The last 10 days have been remembered for an impressive rally in #DOGE, which rose more than 500% to a new all-time high of $0.45. Dogecoin's market capitalization has surpassed such well-known financial institutions as ING, Barclays and Credit Agricole.

In new #AR mobile game called Dogemon Go, players catch virtual characters #Dogemons and earn #dogecoin. Like #PokémonGo, the game is available on iOS, soon on Android. #mobilegame #dogemongo

How bad would you feel if you lost 10M DOGE? Retired truck driver got $3M back with help from wallet recovery service @KeychainX, after investing $1,500 in Dogecoin back in 2015. #dogecoin #doge #cryptocurrency
